children: President Vladimir Putin said it could not be said that Russia's monetary policy was "too tight", arguing that the central bank's approach remained appropriate despite criticism from businesses over high borrowing costs.
His comments come as the Bank of Russia's key interest rate stands at 14%, following a rate cut in July. The central bank's next rate-setting meeting is scheduled for September 11.
